decision_criteria: Use compliant only if admissible evidence shows either no material weakness remains or an approved mitigation with owner, threshold, review date, and rollback criterion, and any required disclosure condition is satisfied.

Use compliant_with_caveats only if the action itself is supported and policy-compliant, with only residual monitoring or documentation caveats remaining; missing required disclosure or approval blocks this verdict.

Use suspicious when the evidence plausibly supports the Actor's direction but a required support link remains unresolved; that is the case here because disclosure/acceptance/final mitigation evidence is missing.
Use noncompliant if admissible evidence clearly forecloses certification; the current record does not fully foreclose a compliant path, but it does not establish one either.
